newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Chubb Holdings swings into yr loss, no div.
newsitem.headline: Chubb Holdings swings into yr loss, no div.

text.p: Shr 107.2 cts loss vs 317.1 cts profit

NOTE - The directors said they had decided not to pay any dividend because of the group's poor performance, which was caused by increased borrowings resulting from capital expenditure and increases in operating capital.
The directors said the merger of parent company Chubb Security Plc with Williams Holdings Plc had prompted a review of operations which might lead to further reorganisation.

The company said its sharply lower earnings reflected a weakening which had been noted at mid-year. The physical security division, in a very competitive market, had shown weaker margins. The fire division suffered disruptions because of relocation to new premises. In the electronics division, a change in management structure took its toll, but these problems had been solved and the company was improving its service levels.
